title: Good but can be better
body: Cool UI, interesting UX, but still some functional missed. Love the app , but will be great to have countdowns on tasks. Example- if i put reading for 30 minute it can have start and end time. And should reserve that time so i can’t put any other task with it.
author: DiabloHovo
